## Embedding Models, Vector Databases & Semantic Search

This is a curated collection of my writing on **text embeddings**, **sparse retrieval**, **vector databases**, and **semantic search architecture**.

If you're building search systems or RAG pipelines, start here:

- **[HyperRun](hyperrun.html)** — A self-hosted AI docs widget with semantic code search
- **[HyperRun + FastHTML](hyperun_fasthtml.html)** — Streaming chat architecture with HTMX and SSE
- **[Late Interaction](late_interaction.html)** — ColBERT and multi-vector retrieval explained
- **[BM25 from Scratch](sparse_embedding/bm25_from_scratch.html)** — Implementing classical sparse retrieval
- **[BM25 + Qdrant for Arabic](sparse_embedding/bm25_arabic_qdrant.html)** — Practical sparse+dense hybrid search
- **[BM25 Benchmarks](sparse_embedding/bm25_benchmark_full.html)** — Full comparison across datasets
- **[Vector Database Book](vector_database_book.html)** — Notes on building vector search systems
